source: Presidential Decree No. 442 (Labor Code of the Philippines)
notes: Complete Labor Code chunked following 200-800 word guideline with flexibility for semantic completeness. Includes: Preliminary Title (Articles 1-11), Book One (Human Resources Development, Articles 12-60), Book Two (Pre-Employment, Articles 61-109), Book Three (Conditions of Employment, Articles 110-157), Book Four (Health Safety and Social Welfare, Articles 157-210), Book Five (Labor Relations, Articles 211-277), Book Six (Post Employment, Articles 278-287), and Book Seven (Penal Provisions, Articles 288-302). All 65 chunks completed (files 00-64). Fixed article overlap in chunks 59-61 on 2025-11-16.
structure_note: Book Five (Labor Relations) is the largest section with 16 chunks covering NLRC, Bureau of Labor Relations, labor organizations, unfair labor practices, collective bargaining, strikes/lockouts, and special provisions. Articles 264-272 split into separate chunks (59: prohibited acts, 60: assistance/foreign, 61: penalties).
